## Contributing Code

Thank you for your interest in contributing to the project!

Please read through these guidelines in order to smoothly integrate your changes.

### Identifying Work
[GitHub Issues] are kept as up to date and accurate as possible.
If you are looking for a task to pick up, please ask SoundTech about any Issues with the [Help Wanted] tag.

### Branching and Pull Requests

Development is done following the Gitflow workflow, which involves creating feature branches from the `develop` branch and merging them back into `develop` after thorough testing and review.

- Fork the repository and clone it to your local machine.
- Create a new branch for your changes.
- Make your changes and ensure they pass all tests.
- Submit a pull request with a clear description of your changes.
- Be responsive to feedback and make necessary adjustments.

## Code Quality and Testing

To maintain high code quality, there are a few helpful tools put in place.
These are not meant to block your contributions nor get in the way, but are encouraged to ensure consistency and maintainability.

- Detekt for Static Code Analysis: A tool that checks for code smells and warns about potential issues in your code.
